svg.title: European material production: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM

cc:Work.dc:title: European material production: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM
cc:Work.dc:description: European production in a 2 × 3 layout: NDC above NDC+LTT, with cement, steel and aluminium columns. Each category pairs OMNIA-ENGAGE on the left with hatched GCAM on the right. Historical bars use the model's own no-CE scenario at 2019 (OMNIA) or 2021 (GCAM); future categories show no, medium and high CE in the EU in 2050. EU+ scenarios are excluded. OMNIA metal output stacks primary and secondary routes; GCAM reports total metal production only. GCAM's grey hatched total is not assigned to a production route. Cement excludes clinker; clinker is omitted because GCAM provides no corresponding series. OMNIA secondary shares are shown within sufficiently large segments. Future annotations use each model's own no-CE total under the same climate pathway in 2050: 100 × (scenario/reference − 1). Sector scales match across pathways and models. OMNIA totals sum EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects its supplied EU-27 aggregate once, without adding country rows. These aggregates are checked against available-country sums. OMNIA regional boundaries include some small non-EU territories; membership is exported explicitly, so the two boundaries are not assumed identical. Source scenario names are retained: OMNIA baseline_* and GCAM LTT_* are displayed as NDC+LTT; ndc_* and NDC_* are displayed as NDC. Matching labels do not establish identical policy assumptions. OMNIA missing activity = zero (provisional); GCAM missing values remain gaps. Exact source variables, units, region memberships, conversion factors and calculation references accompany the source CSVs.
